tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 20b - responsePathway conditions must be simple triples. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - measured live on the round-20 mint (v116): the named-time route reached the offered-anchor search, the gateway returned anchor_exact true, the slots were correct (08/13 10:45 am held), but the flow still landed on the intermediate offer node instead of the confirmation gate. Root cause: round 20 wrote the pathway condition as the triple ['anchor_exact', '==', 'true AND slot_count >= 1'] - Bland compares the VALUE literally, so it can never equal that string; the fallback ['anchor_exact', '!=', 'true AND slot_count >= 1'] then matched everything. Bland responsePathway conditions are [field, operator, value] with a single literal value; compound logic must be expressed by ORDERING separate rows, not by packing AND/OR into the value. THE FIX - copy every artifact from /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD27/gl-round20-fix/ into CWD and change: (1) In n_goal_search_offered_anchor's responsePathways, keep the existing ordering (ok != true -> n_goal_ask; slot_count == 0 -> n_goal_ask) and replace the last two rows with simple triples: ['anchor_exact', '==', 'true'] -> n_gate_1 and ['anchor_exact', '!=', 'true'] -> n_time_pick_offer. Mirror the same simplification in the corresponding edge labels/descriptions so the graph reads consistently. (2) Audit EVERY responsePathway in the whole graph and split any other value containing AND/OR into ordered single-condition rows preserving intent; report each one you changed in DEBUG.md. (3) VALIDATOR: update assertion 20 so it asserts the SIMPLE triples (anchor_exact == true -> n_gate_1, anchor_exact != true -> n_time_pick_offer) and ADD a general rule to the validator: no responsePathway condition value anywhere in the graph may contain AND or OR - structured FAIL naming the offending node and row. Keep assertions 1-19 intact. Your validator must PASS your new draft and FAIL the untouched round-20 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD27/gl-round20-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing the compound-condition rule. (4) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (5) DEBUG.md: the live evidence, the Bland condition-shape rule as a durable convention, every row you changed, regeneration command; mention extract/prompt/compress context as before.
tasks.verified: Every responsePathway condition is a simple triple, the anchor_exact == true row routes to the confirmation gate and its != fallback to the closest-offer node, the validator now rejects compound conditions anywhere in the graph, and every guard from rounds 8-19 still holds.
